(i) rewriting calculus provides the theoretical basis for combining proof search and proof check; (ii) rewriting calculus provides a natural framework to relate proof search and proof representation; (iii) deduction modulo is a powerful tool for combining proof search, proof check and proof representation, and (iv) the rewriting calculus based proof representation is a natural basis for combining proof check and proof search.
proof search and check for equational theorems are related to deduction modulo and that proof search and representation for inductive theorems are based on the notion of rewrite closure.
